card.name: The word of after number or count
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after a count word such as "number" or after a figure like "127" or "ten", before the things being counted (patients, tablets, supporters). Weaker on "approx" before a time.

modes.label: "of" after number
modes.description: "of" follows the word number (or lowest/highest/same number) and leads into what is counted.
modes.example: the higher number<< of>> tablets is taken with the first daily dose

modes.label: "of" after a figure
modes.description: "of" follows a numeral or quantity word and introduces the group it refers to.
modes.example: Rash resolved in 84% of the 127<< of>> patients.

modes.label: Abbreviated approx
modes.description: The abbreviation "approx" before a time in an infusion instruction.
modes.example: Infuse over 15 minutes beginning<< approx>>. 30 min before the start
